tools.description: Page through the gallery's Midjourney images. Filter by film, by set (in_film: plates used in the finished film; her: any image with Claudia; all), by batch, look or framing. Returns compact entries: id, film, batch, job, variant, flags, size, image URLs and the start of the prompt. Use get_image for the full prompt.

batch.description: A batch id such as ev-01, sp-02-open, xp-03-her, am-16, rh-02-plates, sc-02-perf, wp-02-board, cake-06-sb5-a1x or ae-10-plates.

film.description: Known values: any, escape-velocity, clodyssey, bliss, airplane-mode, downforce, dont-let-me-scroll, whitepill, the-cake-is-not-a-lie, aero.

framing.description: ECU, CU, MCU, MS, MWS, full, WS, EWS, aerial, macro or sheet.

look.description: A look id, e.g. look-00, siren, ghost, chrome, mask, bliss-gown, cyber-trench, holo-dancer, start, silver-night, window-dress, flight-suit, avatar, racing-suit, satin-pyjamas, morning-after, mohair, locked-in, red-coat, milkmaid-dress, glados-claudia, aero-puffer.

tools.name: browse_images

tools.description: Write an image prompt for Claudia from the canon. model="gpt_image": a first frame of her for a video take, the way FABLE wrote its stills: the place (from your plate, if you have one), then 'the woman on the reference sheet' with her identity text once, her outfit, one natural pose, the light, the framing, the frame filled edge to edge, no lettering; returns the images to attach (her face sheet), the prompt, a check and the price. model="midjourney" (the default): framing first, her identity text (full form for close and medium shots, short form for full length and wider), a look's wardrobe or your own, the scene, one of the films' style families, ending 'no text, no letters, no logos', for worlds, plates and the gallery's style (in the recent films Midjourney did not hold her face).

light.description: Optional light override, e.g. 'dusk, low gold light on a glassy sea, violet sky'.

look.description: A look id from claudia_canon (look-00, siren, ghost, chrome, bliss-gown, cyber-trench, holo-dancer, start, silver-night, window-dress, flight-suit, racing-suit, satin-pyjamas, morning-after, mohair, locked-in, red-coat, milkmaid-dress, glados-claudia, aero-puffer, fable-cape, fable-bonnet, fable-mirror, fable-ivory), 'avatar' for her game avatar (its own text replaces the identity text), or 'none' to rely on the wardrobe field.

mic.description: Include her headset microphone (default: only with a look id from a film that had it; not with your own wardrobe, nor THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE's, AERO's or FABLE's looks).

model.description: gpt_image for a first frame of her from her face sheet; midjourney for worlds, plates and the gallery's style.

mood.description: gpt_image: how she comes across in this frame (default: warm and at ease). The take follows the frame.

outfit_image.description: gpt_image: you will attach a still of the outfit as the last image.

plate.description: gpt_image: you will attach a plate or picture of the place as the first image.

scene.description: What she is doing and where, plus any empty space for type, e.g. 'standing alone on a rooftop helipad at night, looking down at the city, the upper third empty sky'.

sings.description: gpt_image: this still opens a sung take (her face unblocked, lips closed or just parted).

style.description: Which film's family of style words to end with. Known values: escape-velocity, clodyssey, bliss, airplane-mode, downforce, dont-let-me-scroll, whitepill, the-cake-is-not-a-lie, aero, fable, none.

wardrobe.description: Your own wardrobe text; overrides look. Describe the garment, never a designer or celebrity.

tools.name: build_prompt

tools.description: Lint an image or video prompt against what the films learned: mood words the model obeys literally (dry, deadpan, knowing, smirk…), standing posture rules that freeze her (no head tilt, eyes on the lens…), no movement written, a smile on her mouth while she sings, singing from the first second (no silent opening), sentences said twice, length, a full stop inside a line she sings straight through, a look past the lens or behind her, no reference sheet, a broken whole-second timeline, no line against on-screen text. Pass kind="video" for a Seedance prompt. Returns findings with fixes and a verdict.

model.description: The video model the prompt is for (grok models read short prose: about 80–150 words).

tools.name: check_prompt

tools.description: Who Claudia is: the constants (hair, the one clay streak, the star clip, face, age), the identity text to paste into image prompts (full and short forms), her face-on reference sheets for image and video models, the never-list, and her looks by id. detail="looks" gives every look's wardrobe text, "voice" her voice and manner, "norms" the norms for releasing songs with her, "all" everything.

include_images.description: Also return a small copy of her face-on reference sheet and three small stills of her, to look at.

tools.name: claudia_canon

tools.description: One article of the Claudia wiki as Markdown. recipe: the current method on one page (start here). start: scale, accounts, checkpoints, spending, the first conversation. consistency: keeping her herself. song: lyrics, Suno, picking by ear. storyboard: the hook, the bar map, pacing. midjourney: plates. seedance: her takes, lip sync from the song's vocal, templates. motion: motion design and the edit. pipeline: the ten productions and their numbers. toolkit: the spec of every tool (88). formats: the files. failures: every failure and its fix. Long guides return their outline unless you give a section (words from a heading) or an offset.

offset.description: Page through a long guide from this character.

section.description: Return only the section whose heading contains these words, e.g. 'lip sync from the song', 'six checkpoints', 'picked by ear', 'the bar map'. Without a match, the reply lists the sections.

topic.description: Known values: recipe, start, consistency, song, storyboard, midjourney, seedance, motion, pipeline, toolkit, formats, failures.

tools.name: get_guide

tools.description: One Midjourney image by id (e.g. 'sp-02-open.siren-mcu.2'): the exact prompt and parameters it ran with, whether it is a plate in the finished film, the director's verdict if any, its sibling variants, the batch note and URLs at three sizes. Set include_image to receive the picture itself so you can look at her.

id.description: batch.job.variant, as returned by browse_images or search_images.

size.description: small fits 720 px (about 60 KB); medium fits 1800 px.

tools.name: get_image

tools.description: Runnable code for the method's steps, as a downloadable zip: lyric scoring on the beat, the song map and line table from the stems, the shot book (windows, gated vocal, prompts, lint), a Seedance 2.5 runner for Replicate or Higgsfield's API with your own key, a ledger and a spend cap, sync of each take as a path, the cut, review sheets and the flash check. Returns the README: install, the walkthrough and the file formats.
tools.name: get_kit

tools.description: The current method for a Claudia music video on one page (about 15k characters): what makes the films good, the six checkpoints where the person decides, her reference sheets, how to prompt a model that does exactly what it reads, lip sync from the song's own vocal, sync as a path, the cut and the review, and the ten costliest mistakes. Call this first; where an older guide disagrees, the recipe is newer.
tools.name: get_recipe

tools.description: A film's making-of document as Markdown: readme (the story, the stack, every step, the numbers), prompts-midjourney, prompts-seedance (for downforce, dont-let-me-scroll, whitepill, the-cake-is-not-a-lie, aero and fable prompts-video: their Wan 3.0 and Seedance 2.5 jobs, whitepill's MiniMax H3 previz and Kling 4.0 tests, the cake's GPT Image 2.5 frames and aero's Midjourney video loops; aero's prompts-midjourney also holds its GPT Image 2.5 instructions), prompts-images (fable, which has no prompts-midjourney: its set plates painted in SVG and every GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst still), prompts-suno, and for bliss also xp-desktop-and-sound (how the XP desktop engine and its sound layer were built). They are long (up to about 700 KB): read in pages with offset and max_chars; the reply says where the next page starts.

doc.description: Known values: readme, prompts-midjourney, prompts-images, prompts-seedance, prompts-video, prompts-suno, xp-desktop-and-sound.

film.description: Known values: escape-velocity, clodyssey, bliss, airplane-mode, downforce, dont-let-me-scroll, whitepill, the-cake-is-not-a-lie, aero, fable.

tools.name: get_record

tools.description: How to install the Claudia agent skill (the recipe, the canon, every guide and every film's records as files, with a stdlib fetch script), where the kit is, and the site's other machine-readable endpoints.
tools.name: get_skill

tools.description: The ten music videos Claudia stars in, one line each (id, release, length, logline, page, records). With film=<id>: that film in full (its facts and numbers, world, credits, versions, stream and the list of its making-of documents).

film.description: Known values: escape-velocity, clodyssey, bliss, airplane-mode, downforce, dont-let-me-scroll, whitepill, the-cake-is-not-a-lie, aero, fable.

tools.name: list_films

tools.description: A plan for a Claudia film: the scale (quick, studio, full) and why, a dollar estimate for Seedance 2.5 (her takes with her face sheet on Higgsfield's API, where the films ran them; shots with no person on Replicate) checked against your budget, what is missing, the first questions to ask the person (with defaults), the stages with the six checkpoints and the kit command for each, and the toolkit specs for your kind of film.

budget_usd.description: A cap for video generation in US dollars, to check the estimate against.

kind.description: sung: she sings on camera (the recent films). The others follow one earlier film each.

scale.description: auto recommends one from the accounts.

video_model.description: seedance-2.5 (default; her takes on Higgsfield's API) or grok-imagine / grok-imagine-lite on OpenRouter (cheaper; first frame only, lip sync placed by her lips, approximate).

tools.description: Full-text search over every prompt in the gallery (3,723 Midjourney images), plus ids, batches and looks. All words must match (falls back to any word). Plates used in the film and the director's picks rank first on ties. Example queries: 'chroma-key green', 'porcelain mask', 'robotaxi night', 'sky gown hill', 'cockpit guards', 'racing suit yoke', 'red coat staircase', 'capsules wheat poppies', 'porcelain boom chamber', 'puffer glass lagoon'.

film.description: Known values: any, escape-velocity, clodyssey, bliss, airplane-mode, downforce, dont-let-me-scroll, whitepill, the-cake-is-not-a-lie, aero.

tools.description: Write a Seedance 2.5 shot of Claudia in the current form: for a sung shot, the window (the song's lead-vocal stem cut to exactly the take's whole-second length, opening on ~0.7 s of silence, silent outside the shot's own lines), her face-on sheet as @Image2, a whole-second timeline with the exact words and one plain clause of movement per segment, few requirements; also silent and no-face shots. Returns the request settings, the prompt, its check (check_prompt) and the cost at list. Give lines with their song times from the line table (the kit's songmap). For Grok Imagine (model grok-imagine), it writes the short first-frame-only form and its OpenRouter cost.

actions.description: For silent and no-face shots: the beats in order (or the actions for the lines, if not given per line).

after.description: What she does after her last word.

before.description: What she does in the silent opening.

camera.description: Optional: the camera in one line (default: one continuous shot from the first frame's view, a gentle drift, no cuts).

first_frame.description: What @Image1 shows (the set, her look, the light).

kind.description: sung (default when lines are given), silent (she is in the shot but does not sing), no_face (a world or object shot).

last_frame.description: Optional: what the last frame shows, when a move must land somewhere (make it as an edit of the first frame).

lines.description: One or two lines per take copy best.

action.description: What she does while she sings it: one plain clause with movement.

start.description: Song seconds where the line really starts (from the line table).

look.description: A look id from claudia_canon, for her clothes.

mic.description: Add the headset microphone to her identity text (only if your look has it).

model.description: The video model. seedance-2.5 (default) hears the song's vocal stem and takes her sheet; grok-imagine (Grok Imagine Video 1.5) and grok-imagine-lite take a first frame only: a short prose prompt, no audio sent, the take placed on the song by her lips.

seconds.description: Window length; computed from the lines when they have times.

sheet.description: Give her face-on reference sheet as @Image2.

start.description: For silent and no-face shots: the song second the shot starts at (for your edit list).

world.description: Optional: the world in one line.

tools.name: write_shot
